title: Item 5 · Problem messages that vanish
subtitle: Drift in Black Belt. The rulebook says a problem message never closes by itself (§3.5, §8). Color Belt, Star, Camps and Finance follow it with the amber bar that stays. Black Belt shows its refusals in the 5-second toast instead — “Too late to undo here. Ask an admin.”, “Only an admin can do that…”, “This candidate was deleted.”, and why a button is grayed. Its own plan said banners; nobody decided toasts. (Prospects' “That prospect no longer exists.” was approved as a toast, v0.615.) (Preview screenshots at PC size · fake data)

row.caption: 1. Black Belt: with private details hidden, Add candidate is grayed…
2. …tapping it explains why in a toast that is gone after 5 seconds. Its “Too late to undo here” and “Only an admin can do that” messages work the same way.

items.caption: 3. Color Belt (Star, Camps, Finance the same): a problem stays on screen in the amber bar — “Lily Brooks wasn't marked paid. Check the connection and try again.” with Retry and ×, and the row says “Not saved”.

columns.label: Proposed (option B) · problems stay on screen

items.caption: 4. Black Belt's refusals use the same amber bar, which stays until it's closed — here “Too late to undo here. Ask an admin to undo the payment.”
5. Why a button is grayed sits right next to it in gray, as Star and Color Belt already explain things.

columns.note: Copies what's already there: the shared amber bar (Retry when the thing can be tried again, × to close) and Star's and Color Belt's gray explanation lines. Toasts stay for “done” messages only. Pictures 4 and 5 are drawn over the real page; nothing in the app was changed.

footer:
Your choice — one question:
A · Keep as today. + no work. − the Grandmaster can miss why something didn't happen; Black Belt breaks the rule the other sections follow.
B · Recommended: problems always stay on screen. Refusals and errors use the amber bar until closed (rules §3.5, §8); the reason a button is grayed is a gray line next to it; toasts only say something was done. Prospects' approved “That prospect no longer exists.” toast would move to the bar too. + one way everywhere; nothing important disappears. − small rework in Black Belt (and one Prospects message).
C · Keep the toasts, but problem toasts stay until tapped. + less rework. − a third kind of message; a toast in the corner is easy to overlook on a tablet.
